variant.briefing:
Hey,

Just got word that [Location] has finished sorting and packing a few boxes of goods. Next step is for us to get them over to [Destination]. 

Getting these goods sold will support CFP operations and show folks that good, honest work is possible in this system. You available for the run? 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
